" Tsang Yoh Chi appointed by the court for accused.

Mr. Kum:- The 1st, accused admitted that he distributed pamphlets in the Settlement, but denied that he did so in Chapel, so the settlement police will take action in this case, therefore the application by the S.P.S.B. is out of the question.

Judge to Kum:- Outline the charge please.

Mr. Kum :- At 11.50.p.m. on the 18/4/33 detectives with a representative of the S.P.S.B. went to No.1103 San Yih Li Washing Rd, armed with a warrant from this court, and the two accused were arrested and seized communistic literature. The 1st, accused admits that he distributed literature in the Settlement and said that a man named Le handed them to him & that each time he gave him 20 cents, but he does not know where the man is at present, and said that the 2nd, accused had lived in his house for one week. The 2nd, accused used to live with his parents, but they turned him out of the house, so he went to live with the 1st, accused. There is no evidence to offer against the 2nd, accused so I ask that the charge be withdrawn against him.

C.D.C.157:- Corroborated police advocates outlining, and added the 1st, accused stated that a man named Le Pen Kung handed him the pamphlets, but said that he did not know where he was at present. It is correct that the 2nd, accused used to live at No.13 Y/Poo Rd. with his mother, who turned him out of the house, and he went to live with the 1st, accused, but it has been ascertained that he is in no way connected with the case.

K.S. Kum 先生代表警方出庭。
" 法庭为被告指派 Tsang Yoh Chi。

Kum 先生：- 第一被告承认他在租界分发小册子，但否认在闸北这样做，因此租界警方将对此案采取行动，所以上海市公安局的申请不予考虑。

法官问 Kum：- 请概述指控内容。

Kum 先生：- 1933年4月18日晚上11点50分，侦探会同上海市公安局代表，持本庭逮捕令前往华盛路三益里1103号，逮捕了两名被告并查获共产主义文献。第一被告承认他在租界分发文献，并称是一个姓黎的人交给他的，每次给他20分钱，但他不知道此人目前在哪里，并称第二被告在他家住了一个星期。第二被告原本与父母同住，但被赶出家门，于是去和第一被告同住。没有证据指控第二被告，因此我请求撤销对他的指控。

Charge Offence against the Internal Security or State Cont to Art.103(1)CCnC
For that they at 11.55 p.m. 18-4-33 at 1103 San Yih Lee, Washing Road were found to be in possession a quantity of communistic literature.

2nd BRANCH OF THE KIANGSU HIGH COURT. A.M.

Mr K.S.Kum appeared for the Police.

Proceedings
Mr Kum :- This is a case of assistance rendered by the P.S.-Bureau. It appears that at 11.50.p.m. on the 18th inst, a party of detectives, accompanied by a representative of the P.S.B. visited premises No 1103 San Yih Li, Whashing Road, on authority of a warrant issued by this court. Inside the premises the two accused were arrested, and a quantity of Communistic pamphlets seized (pro). The 1st accused states that he is not a communist, but that his friend had asked him to distribute the pamphlets. The 2nd accused states that he had no knowledge of the pamphlets, and he is not a communist. The representative of the P.S.B. is present in court, and is making application for the handing over of the accused. The Police however desires that the representative establish a Prima-Facie case against the accused, whereby the court will be able to determine whether or not an offence has been committed.

（左侧手写批注：Efforts should be made to obtain specimens of the pamphlets. J.S. Cton. D.S.R. 21/4）

C.D.C.157 :- At 11.50.p.m. on the 18th inst a representative of the P.S.B, accompanied by a party of Settlement detectives, went to 1103 Whashing Road (San Yih Lee), and arrested the two accused, and seized a quantity of communistic literature.(pro).

Chang Yang Woo, P.S.B.Representative:- I am given to understand that the alias of the 1st accused is (Lee Bing), and is the writer for the Communistic Party. The 2nd accused is concerned with the 1st accused in communistic activities. The house where the literature was seized, was hired by the 1st accused.

Judge to the representative:- You have not produced sufficient evidence to warrant the handing over of the accused. At the next hearing you better establish definitely whether these accused have committed an offence in Chinese Territory or not. Then the court can decide the issue of handing over.

庭审过程
Kum 先生：- 这是一起由市公安局协助的案件。看来在本月18日晚上11点50分，一队侦探在市公安局代表的陪同下，凭本庭签发的搜查令，前往 Washing Road（原文如此）三益里1103号的处所。在该处所内，两名被告被捕，并查获大量共产主义传单（物证）。第一被告声称他不是共产党员，而是他的朋友让他分发这些传单。第二被告声称他对传单一无所知，且不是共产党员。市公安局代表出庭，并申请移交被告。然而，警方希望该代表能确立针对被告的表面案情，以便法庭能够判定是否发生了犯罪行为。

（左侧手写批注：应努力获取传单样本。J.S. Cton. D.S.R. 4月21日）

C.D.C.157 :- 本月18日晚上11点50分，一名市公安局代表在一队租界侦探的陪同下，前往 Washing Road（原文如此）1103号（三益里），逮捕了两名被告，并查获大量共产主义文献。（物证）。

Chang Yang Woo，市公安局代表：- 据我了解，第一被告的化名为 (Lee Bing)，是共产党的撰稿人。第二被告参与第一被告的共产主义活动。查获文献的房屋是由第一被告租赁的。

法官对代表说：- 你尚未提供足以 warrant（授权/保证）移交被告的充分证据。在下一次听证会上，你最好明确确定这些被告是否在中国领土犯了罪。然后法庭可以决定移交问题。

At 11-55.p.m. 13-4-33, D.J. Moore, A.J. Tcheremshansky

In a back room on the ground floor two men named
(毛詹凌)
Chen Sih Jue (陈锡如) and Mau Tsung Tsing were arrested

was found under the bed.

named made a statement (copy attached) as to how he

literature and stated that he has only lived with

The following is the statement of Chen Sih Jui (        ),
native of Anhwei ........................................ taken by me D.S. Moore
at Yulin Road ....... on the 19-4-33 ............ and interpreted by Clerk Liao.

My name is Chen Sih Jue (陈仕如), age 22, native of Anhwei
and I reside at 1103 San Yih Li, Yangchow Road along with Mau
Jung Tsing (毛春清). I have never been to school in my life and
can only read and write very little. I came to Shanghai from
my native place in July 1931 and worked in the Tsong Shing Brass
Works, Tongshan Road for over a year and was residing at a
carpenters' shop 137 Alcock Road. For three months after leaving
the Brass Works I was unemployed and then secured employment at
the Ewo Cotton Mill, Y'poo Road for the next three months. Since
then I have been unemployed.

Before I came to Shanghai I met a Shuchow man named Li Pao
Kung (李宝松) in a match factory at my native place and we both
came to Shanghai together. Li Pao Kung always kept his Shanghai
address a secret from me, but at the beginning of this year we
met on Yangchow Road and because I was unemployed he engaged a
room for me at 1103 San Yih Li, Yangchow Road. Since then I
have met Li Pao Kung at the alleyway entrance almost every 2-3
days and about every second visit he has given me some handbills
to distribute to workers in the Yangtszepoo District. I have
distributed handbills to workers on a vacant piece of ground on
Yangchow Road on 4 or 5 different occasions. Whenever
I met Li Pao Kung he always gave me money to buy food in addition
to which he has always paid the rent for me since he engaged
my room.

The pamphlets seized by the Police in my room at the time of
my arrest were given to me by Li Pao Kung at about 4.p.m. April
16, 1933 when I met him at the entrance to the San Yih Li. I was

本人姓名陈仕如（Chen Sih Jue），现年 22 岁，籍贯安徽，现与毛春清（Mau Jung Tsing）同住扬州路三益里 1103 号。本人平生未曾入学，仅识少许文字。本人于 1931 年 7 月自原籍来沪，在通山路宗兴铜厂工作一年多，期间居住于阿尔科克路 137 号一家木匠铺。离开工厂后失业三个月，随后在杨树浦路怡和纱厂受雇三个月。此后一直失业。

在来上海之前，本人在原籍的一家火柴厂结识了一位名叫李宝松（Li Pao Kung）的舒城人，我们一同来到上海。李宝松始终对我隐瞒其在上海的住址，但今年年初我们在扬州路相遇，因我失业，他便在扬州路三益里 1103 号为我租了一间房。此后，我几乎每两三天就在弄堂口见到李宝松一次，大约每隔一次见面，他就会给我一些传单，让我分发给杨树浦区的工人。我曾四、五次在扬州路的一块空地上向工人分发传单。每次见到李宝松，除了为我支付自租房以来的租金外，他总是给我钱买食物。
